ran.Genesis: seeds every node (mirror) and anchors every mesh component
ran.Nexus: registers every node + per-iteration state; telemeter each iteration
ran.Oasis: S = w·[nov,ten,coh,res] with params.json weights; commit/buffer/recycle at make_env threshold (0.65 base, +0.2 rest bump, + damper pressure)
ran.NaCl polarity mesh: oro_mesh.PolarityMesh: BFS charges from Genesis, process_polarities, frustrated edges, inversion_holds
ran.Dictator/Transcriber: native Dictator.stream + Transcriber (critical = colonize/exit); relay Dictator/Transcriber keyword flags
ran.Levy: native LevyLedger.assess pulse; relay OroboroLevy; Levy kind weights drive salience
ran.Damper: native formula p=(1-a)p+a*g*(spike+levy_gain*levy_spike), a=0.35, g=0.08; relay pipeline damped pressure
ran.Delta reconciliation: deterministic: superseded figures exit and pass weight to the later/corrected node; contradictions flagged; relay computeDelta per cluster
ran.Isolate/recombine: relay OroboroPipeline isolates most-drifted cluster when incoherent; isolated cluster cut from outside propagation next iteration
ran.Homeostasis: make_env rest_load 40 / rest_bump 0.2 on committed count
ran.Self-repair flag: Edge.repaired set on contradictions resolved by delta reconciliation (heat model of _adapt_niche not applicable)
ran.Adaptive surface (ported rule): AdaptiveFurn.maybe_adapt L_tgt interpolation + _nacl_votes 3-vote majority sets per-cluster detail

not_applicable.Dream-catcher weave: build_system_mesh / run_dreamcatcher_weave build a fixed niche/skeleton geometry; no clustering operation exists to apply to a findings graph. Its purpose (odd-loop frustration) is used via PolarityMesh.
not_applicable.Smart magnets: defined only as a physical force (guidance) and a leak-halving hold (plumbing); nothing applies to a findings graph
not_applicable.Sponge: not used in any study; not applied here
not_applicable.Self-repairing niche heat model: _adapt_niche needs fail/exit/colonize heat on niche edges; no analogue
not_applicable.Clustering: Levy-weighted label propagation is glue code, not an Oroboro component
